name: Tiny NeRF
definition: A compact neural network architecture for NeRF, consisting of three linear layers with ReLU activations, designed to reduce model size compared to the standard NeRF.
summary: Tiny NeRF is a compression pipeline that transforms voxel grids into the frequency domain via block-wise DCT to prune and quantize coefficients, reducing storage by over 100x with minimal quality loss.
